## Drug Label Information

Updated September 21, 2025

If you are a consumer or patient please visit this version.

  * Download DRUG LABEL INFO: PDF XML
  * Official Label (Printer Friendly)

View All SectionsClose All Sections

  * INDICATIONS & USAGE

For debridement and promotion of normal healing of hyperkeratotic surface lesions, particularly where healing is retarded by local infection, necrotic tissue, ﬁbrinous or purulent debris or eshar. Urea is useful for the treatment of hyperkeratotic conditions such as dry, rough skin, dermatitis, psoriasis, xerosis, ichthyosis, eczema, keratosis pilaris, keratosis palmaris, keratoderma, corns and calluses, as well as damaged, ingrown and devitalized nails.

  * CONTRAINDICATIONS

This product is contraindicated in persons with known or suspected hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients of the product.

  * WARNINGS

Avoid contact with eyes, lips and mucous membranes.

  * ADVERSE REACTIONS:

Discontinue use and consult a physician if redness or irritation occurs.

  * DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION

Apply Urea 41% to affected skin twice per day, or as directed by your physician. Rub in until completely absorbed.

Apply to diseased or damaged nail(s) twice per day, or as directed by a physician.

  * HOW SUPPLIED

DERMACURE Urea 41% Cream 8 oz. (227 g): NDC 85477-909-30

  * STORAGE

Store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F) [see USP Controlled
Room Temperature]. Protect from freezing and excessive
heat. Keep container tightly closed.

KEEP THIS AND ALL MEDICATIONS OUT OF THE REACH OF CHILDREN.

  * Descripción

Dermacure es una crema dermatológica Antiinflamatoria, Antipruriginosa y Antibiótica para uso seguro en todas las especies (caninos, equinos y gatos). Contiene Sulfiram, ingrediente antiséptico, queratolítico, queratoplástico y parasiticida, Óxido de Zinc, ejerciendo un efecto emoliente, refrescante y astringente. Producto altamente recomendado en la industria veterinaria.

Beneficios

    * Gracias a su presentación de emulsión dérmica, permite rápida absorción y fácil aplicación.

    * Control efectivo de los procesos dérmicos sin importar su origen debido a su asociación de principios activos.

    * Actúa en presencia de material orgánico.

    * No tiene aroma.

Modo de uso

Aplicar DERMACURE en las zonas afectadas asegurando un buen contacto, 1 a 3 veces al día, durante 5 días. Repetir el tratamiento según criterio del Médico Veterinario. Para uso externo únicamente.

True to a philosophy of “skin science and healing,” DermaCure is formulated with a physiological pH of 5.2 to respect the skin’s natural barrier. By combining nutrient-rich botanicals like Argan and Emu oils with targeted homeopathic actives, this synergy helps address inflammation and swelling while promoting cellular regeneration. It is an essential, fragrance-free ritual for those seeking professional-level care for both acute trauma and daily skin vitality.

### Who is this care for

This therapeutic cream is suitable for individuals looking to:

  * Relieve joint pain, inflammation, strains, and sprains
  * Soothe bruises, sunburns, and acute physical trauma
  * Improve blood circulation and support lymphatic drainage
  * Hydrate and nourish the skin deeply with 100% natural oils

### What to expect

Designed for versatile use, DermaCure provides a clean, unscented application that melts into the skin without leaving a residue. Users can expect visible improvement in skin elasticity and a reduction in localized swelling as the active ingredients work to alleviate congestion. Whether used for athletic recovery or soothing sensitive skin, the formula delivers a balanced, restorative experience that supports the body’s natural healing processes.

## Additional information

Ingredients

  * 20 Homeopathic Actives: Including Arnica Montana, Calendula, and Echinacea, selected to target pain, inflammation, and bruising.
  * Natural Oil Complex (Argan, Emu, Safflower, Coconut): A rich blend of Omegas 3, 6, 7, and 9 that restores the hydrolipidic film and supports collagen.
  * Olivem 1000 & Biovert System: Eco-cert derivatives and natural enzymes that ensure effective absorption and continuous antimicrobial protection.
